free_tier.stated: Starter 512 MB VPS [NZ]: USD 6.50 per month on monthly billing and USD 27.00 per six months on the semi-annual term the marketing page advertises, both as the cart renders ('Monthly:$6.50 USD' and 'Semi-Annually:$27.00 USD', each also printed as the total due today, setup USD 0.00); derived USD 27.00 / 6 months = USD 4.50 per month, matching the page's printed $4.50/mo. The store listing prints monthly starting prices for every tier: 512 MB USD 6.50, 1 GB USD 10.00, 2 GB USD 18.50, 4 GB USD 27.50; the carts of the 1 GB, 2 GB and 4 GB plans price the semi-annual term at USD 42.00, USD 78.00 and USD 114.00 (derived USD 7.00, USD 13.00 and USD 19.00 per month). Annual billing appears only inside the cart's cycle options: the cart render for the 512 MB plan lists USD 54.00 (derived USD 54.00 / 12 = USD 4.50 per month) and USD 108.00. Renewal price: not published on any page read. No sold-out marker in any cart read; every cart read renders the plan with prices and a USD 0.00 setup fee.
